text_f6fd4ff9c63f: Android: use maps with two fingers
text_6ee2039d039a: Place two fingers on the map. Spread them to zoom in or pinch them to zoom out. Drag with one finger to move the map. The map updates after release; a small indicator shows the zoom level during the gesture. No large animated preview is used. This applies to GPS recording, GPS-DEMO, fullscreen and route knowledge. Plus and minus remain available. Tap an operating point briefly to select it. Zooming does not select or delete route points. Recording and original data remain unchanged.
